common_net_error: Network error, please check your connection
update_tips_force: Your version is too old, please download the new package.
main_all_clear: All twelve stages secured. New chapters await.
select_tip: Gather grain with the Peach Gardener, then build your crossbow line
battle_hint_select: Pick a card, then deploy on the field
battle_hint_place: Tap the field to deploy · right click to cancel
battle_hint_retreat: Tap a deployed unit to withdraw it
result_lose_tip: Enemies broke through. Rebuild your line and try again.
guide_collect: Tap falling grain to collect it. Grain fuels everything.
guide_plant_peach: Recruit the Peach Gardener first, it produces grain over time.
guide_plant_archer: Now deploy a Crossbowman. Arrows fire down its lane automatically.
guide_ready: The line is set. Await the Yellow Turbans.
unit_peach_desc: Loyal and steady, produces grain at intervals. The backbone of your economy.
unit_archer_desc: Basic ranged unit, fires arrows down its own lane. Great value.
unit_repeater_desc: Fires two bolts per volley with the same rate, doubling damage output.
unit_crossbow_desc: Heavy engine covering three lanes at once. Expensive but wide-reaching.
unit_iceArcher_desc: Chilled arrows slow enemy movement and biting for a short time.
unit_wall_desc: A living barricade with huge HP that never strikes back.
unit_tallWall_desc: Doubled HP shield wall, the last line against armor and rams.
unit_drum_desc: Beats the drum to boost attack power and speed of units in its lane.
unit_bomber_desc: Explodes on landing, scorching nearby enemies. Ideal against swarms.
unit_fireOx_desc: Ignites a whole lane, instantly burning every enemy in the row.
unit_mine_desc: Buried trap with very low cost. Arms briefly, then explodes on contact.
unit_catapult_desc: Lobs boulders dealing splash damage. Excellent against clusters.
enemy_turban_desc: The most common rebel infantry. Slow, relentless, numerous.
enemy_banner_desc: Banner bearer moving faster than regular infantry.
enemy_iron_desc: Heavy armor must be stripped before the body takes damage.
enemy_cavalry_desc: Fast cavalry that leaps over the first blocker into your back line.
enemy_digger_desc: Digs around the first obstacle and keeps advancing.
enemy_shield_desc: Tower shield with thick armor. Slow but very hard to stop.
enemy_ram_desc: Massive siege engine with terrifying HP and biting damage.
